subject: 1093年大理植物意象：大理竹密枝（原创扩展；物种及历史栽植待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE isolated botanical PROP SPRITE for a realistic ancient Dali kingdom1093 isometric game. Botanical silhouette is an original regional impression, not a claim of exact historical species. True transparent RGBA image; empty background and leaf gaps must be alpha0. Camera orthographic yaw45 degrees and elevation30 degrees, natural three-dimensional plant volume, upright stem. Realistic leaves and bark with muted natural color and fine material texture, softly lit from SCREEN UPPER LEFT. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ambient halo, no ground patch, no soil ball, no dirt, no stone base, no planter, no pot, no landscape, no architecture, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no people, no modern objects. Complete crown and all leaf tips must stay fully inside canvas with generous15% clear transparent margin. Plant is rooted at ONE small central origin on a horizontal contact line near lower-middle of canvas; bottom trunk/stems stop cleanly at the ground contact line, no exposed roots, soil or root ball, nothing and NO shadow extends below that line. This is one isolated plant object, not a scene or a cluster of separate plants. The lower quarter of the image is entirely transparent. One SMALL BAMBOO PLANT object, height3m and foliage width2m, primary jointed culm and closely connected side culms from one tiny basal origin, denser foliage and more slender branches, still transparent gaps between every leaf spray. Natural upright silhouette, no separate clumps or forest.
negative: 背景、地台、土团、盆器、景观、文字、水印、现代物、人物、地面投影、枝叶裁切、根线下实物
root_measurement: 原图view_image(detail=original)目读真实茎干/草根接触线，结合alpha>=32主体点核对；约±2px，不以全部噪点bbox底冒充。
visual_review: 已逐张view_image原图：完整单株/同源竹枝，无地台、盆器、土团或投影；竹疏密、树窄圆冠可辨，叶隙有透明，光从左上。真实根以下仅边缘抗锯齿及低alpha噪点，交root纯矩形透明边裁整；不宣称精确测角通过。
